name: TLGY Acquisition Corporation Unit
summary: TLGY Acquisition Corporation is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, and the units consist of one ordinary share and one-half of one warrant. The company focuses its search on a target business operating in the Technology, Media, and Telecommunications (TMT) industry. It is headquartered in Hong Kong.
